title: Remote access tunnel cuts out
description: Working from home, the company remote access connection drops out every so often and I lose access to internal sites until I log in again.

title: GlobalProtect disconnecting all afternoon
description: The secure connection client kicks me off roughly twice an hour. I have to sign back in each time.

title: Locked out after too many attempts
description: I typed my password wrong a few times and now Windows says my account is locked. I can't get into anything.

title: Password expired and I can't change it
description: Got a message that my password expired, but the change password screen rejects everything and now I can't sign in.

title: Can't print to the 2nd floor HP
description: Print jobs just sit in the queue and the HP printer by the kitchen shows as unavailable on my machine.

title: Computer takes forever to open apps
description: My work notebook has become sluggish, Excel takes over a minute to open and the fan runs constantly.

title: Phone not getting work emails
description: The mail app on my iPhone stopped receiving new messages yesterday, but webmail on my desktop shows them fine.

title: Need a Visio license
description: Our team needs access to Microsoft Visio for process diagrams, can we get one more seat purchased?

title: Keyboard missing keys
description: Two keys came off my keyboard, I need a replacement keyboard for my desk.

title: Wifi in meeting room 4 is very weak
description: Signal in meeting room 4 is barely one bar and video calls keep freezing there. Other rooms are fine.

title: Request access to finance shared folder
description: I moved to the finance team and need read/write access to the Finance shared folder on the file server.

title: Teams calls have echo
description: Everyone hears an echo of themselves when I'm on Teams calls using my laptop speakers.
